lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows across the lateral flank posterior to the gill slits, with the highest-intensity local maxima concentrated in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal spot alignments, creating a grid-like configuration of high-luminance anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple linear features running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the upper surface and low intensity shadows on the lower surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin in the lower quadrant exhibits a high spatial density of smaller, lower-intensity luminance clusters relative to the primary lateral blobs.
